About This Auction

UPCOMING LAND AUCTION: 109± Acres of Premium Tillable & Elite Recreational Land / Coffey County KS / Live Auction Leroy Community Building 6 pm August 12 / 713 California St Leroy KS 66857 Location: Coffey County, Kansas Don’t miss this rare opportunity to acquire a highly productive income-producing farm that doubles as an incredible recreational retreat! Situated in a premier Kansas neighborhood, this property offers the perfect balance of top-tier agricultural value and world-class hunting. Property Highlights Total Acreage Tillalble: 99± total acres  High-Quality Soils: Primarily highly productive Class 2 Dennis and Woodson Silt loam Prime Location: Located just 1 mile south of Highway 58 on an accessible paved road 1 mile south Leroy KS Commute Times: Conveniently located 1 hour and 30 minutes from the Kansas City metro and 2 hours from Wichita, KS Harvest Efficiency: Close proximity to the LeRoy, Kansas Co-op ensures smooth, quick, and efficient grain delivery Agricultural Excellence If you are looking to expand your farming operation or add a high-caliber investment to your portfolio, this tract delivers. The dirt consists of mostly Class 2 Dennis and Woodson Silt loam, known for its excellent productivity and strong crop yields. With a paved road leading straight to the property and the LeRoy Co-op just minutes away, your harvest logistics will be seamless. World-Class Kansas Recreation Beyond its agricultural power, this farm is a sportsman's paradise. Turkey Hunting: Large numbers of turkeys frequently call this farm home, offering incredible spring hunting. Trophy Whitetails: This neighborhood has a long-standing reputation for producing giant Kansas whitetails. Come fall, heavy cover close by and surrounding travel corridors ensure big bucks will be moving right through your property. It also sits just 1.5 miles off of the famed Neosho River. Auction & Inquiry Information This is a rare chance to buy an acreage that checks every single box. Whether you are an investor, producer, or avid outdoorsman, this Coffey County gem is ready for its next owner. For questions about the property, details on the upcoming auction process, or to schedule a look, contact: Agent: Brian Helman, L2 Realty Inc. Phone: 620-212-2027
